catalog.title: Cattle Artificial Insemination (AI) service catalog
notes: geneticPercentage is the expected genetic composition of the semen / breeding line. It is NOT a market share or production percentage.

Supplier x breed x percentage rows are selectable options for technicians. They do NOT assert that a supplier currently sells every combination; use isActive (or the admin panel after import) to switch combinations off.
No semen price is stored here on purpose. Prices are entered by each technician.
For a graded line (< 100%) the remainder of the composition is assigned to defaults.remainderBreedSlug so that the template breed mix sums to 100.

unsupported.name: Murrah Buffalo
unsupported.reason: The AnimalType enum has no BUFFALO value (CATTLE, GOAT, POULTRY, DOG, CAT, OTHER), so buffalo semen templates cannot be stored or validated. Add a BUFFALO animal type first, then add rows here.
